meta.scope: 334 current standard index entries + 680 signed-in imported monsters, compared to the resolved built-in 5etools catalog; current name/source list rechecked unchanged
meta.note: Rows overlap. They are review relationships, not 213 proven duplicates or 213 disjoint creature families.

method.spelling: Normalized/fuzzy names followed by source-qualified candidate review; no automatic correction.
method.storedRules: Compared all imported raw detail fields after excluding root name, key, source, disabled flag, flavour description and edit event. Normalized self-name, case and whitespace; recursively sorted object keys. Three differently named pairs match this comparison; three more match when languages are also excluded.
method.forms: Explicit current form/option names and reviewed named variants. Shared family does not imply identical rules.
method.sourceRenames: Source-authored reprintedAs relationships. Distinct-role substitutions are marked separately.
method.partialNpc: HP, AC, CR and six scores only; unverified rule equivalence.
method.sameName: 18 current groups: 14 inside imports plus four standard/import overlaps.

limitations: No automatic merge, deletion, rename, import, source switch or builder implementation.
Family grouping is a browse recommendation; preserve version, form, option and NPC differences.
No claim that every renamed NPC or thematic relative in all optional homebrew has been found.
Conclave Dryad Mount remains unassigned; no confident matching built-in creature established.
